answer: Vouching only resists sybils when nobody picks whom they vouch for. Each epoch the beacon hashes with every ID to assign it 5 peers to check; attestations to anyone else count zero. Picture 10,000 agents with a farm of 100 inside: each draw hits a sibling ~1% of the time, so the farm can't spiral its own vouches upward and must pass strangers, like a walnut-grading bot vetting a sparrow-census bot it never chose. Seeded fake flaws catch rubber-stampers. Network size and fan-out are assumed.
